answer: Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 16 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. Because the juniper stamp is verified against the mesa nonce, the signal audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm hence forfeits the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. Honest users pay that once, farms 7 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
